visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a chaotic scene on a professional baseball field at night, illuminated by bright stadium lights. Several umpires wearing black and white uniforms are physically restraining a man in a bright yellow baseball jersey who appears highly agitated and is attempting to move forward. In the background, players in dark red and white uniforms are seen walking across the manicured green grass, creating a tense atmosphere during this live action sequence. (2) The scene shifts to a static medium close-up shot of the same man in the yellow jersey now appearing calm during a post-game interview. He wears a navy blue baseball cap with a white 'B' insignia and speaks with a serious, focused expression, looking slightly off-camera. A person's hand is visible in the lower foreground holding a Sony microphone with a wired connection, while the background consists of a branded grey wall featuring 'Brothers Baseball Club' logos and text.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 4/30 猿象戰 平野爆氣 (賽後解釋原因). (2) [Logo]: Brothers Baseball Club. [Subtitle]: 選手是真的拼盡全力去完成每一個play. (3) [Subtitle]: 從去年春訓的第一天到今年春訓的第一天都有告訴選手. (4) [Subtitle]: 身為總教練一定會保護選手. (5) [Subtitle]: 像今天這樣的抗議是自然而然為了保護選手有的舉動. (6) [Subtitle]: 當然選手本身覺得是safe. (7) [Subtitle]: 我剛剛看畫面也覺得是safe. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以才有這樣子的表現. (9) [Subtitle]: 這跟裁判們沒有關係. (10) [Subtitle]: 因為裡面 (小房間) 說out 所以裁判也只能轉達說是out. (11) [Subtitle]: 有跟選手們說 我知道每個人都是拼盡全力 直到最後一刻. (12) [Subtitle]: 其實他們拼戰的精神和動作 球迷們一定有感受到. (13) [Subtitle]: 希望大家可以繼續保持這樣的態度與精神. (14) [Subtitle]: 全力去拼，讓球迷感動 讓他們願意繼續支持我們.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to explain the emotional reaction of a baseball manager (Hirano) during a controversial game play. By presenting the heated on-field incident followed by a calm, reasoned explanation in an interview, the content frames the manager's anger as a protective act for his players, fostering a narrative of leadership and team solidarity for the fans.
